changes.newValue: Fixed by removing forced restart loop in AsteroidPreview.gd. _on_mining_completed and _on_return_pressed no longer call _restart_starter_run. Player now sees an 'Order incomplete' message but can return home freely.

snapshot.title: Bug: Mission continues looping after player opts to return home with incomplete order
snapshot.description: When a player chooses to return home mid-mission before completing the full ore order, the mission loop continues rather than cleanly exiting. The return-home flow should terminate the mission state.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Selecting return home with an incomplete order exits the mission cleanly
Mission does not restart or loop after the player confirms return home
Partial order state is correctly resolved or discarded on exit

snapshot.implementationNotes: Fixed by removing forced restart loop in AsteroidPreview.gd. _on_mining_completed and _on_return_pressed no longer call _restart_starter_run. Player now sees an 'Order incomplete' message but can return home freely.
